title: Specified data for the four coefficient equivariance clauses
statement: Fix the finite-field and coefficient setting of [def-pur-conventions], a separated finite-type morphism $f_0:X_0\to Y_0$ of separated finite-type $k_0$-schemes, and its geometric base change $f:X\to Y$, smooth of pure relative dimension $d\geq0$ [def-pur-scheme-geometric-frobenius]. Use the finite canonical comparison data [def-pur-finite-geometric-comparison-data], the rational and common-stage data [def-pur-field-geometric-comparison-data], and the specified exceptional coefficient system and a base-field compactification. Define the exceptional strict structure to be inverse pulled-back purity followed by the independent source comparison, purity at the pulled-back object, and the exceptional image of the given strict datum. Define ThreeSquares to mean, in diagrammatic composition order, $Q(\Gamma)c=a\Gamma$, $P(\varepsilon)\phi=(B_{GK}F(c))\varepsilon$, and $P(F(\Gamma)\varepsilon)\phi=(B_{HK}F(a))(F(\Gamma)\varepsilon)$. The finite, integral, rational and common-stage clauses universally quantify these equations over all objects in their specified domains and all strict data. For the integral clause restrict actual completed pullback and the tensor product with the shifted completed Tate line to the finite-Tor full subcategory. Its source comparison is the completed tensor comparison, the shifted roots-of-unity map and the actual pullback-composition square. Its purity is the specified trace-transpose integralIso of [def-pur-canonical-rational-purity-realization]. Its support comparison is the completed proper/open Frobenius exchange of [def-pur-field-geometric-comparison-data], transported through the specified integral left-functor comparison and lifted to finite-Tor objects. All these formulas are the existing definitions relocated without any change of mathematical data.

lean.statement:
def ThreeSquares {CX : Type uX} {CY : Type uY}
    [Category.{vX} CX] [Category.{vY} CY]
    (Q : CX ⥤ CX) (P : CY ⥤ CY) (F : CX ⥤ CY)
    {K : CY} {HK GK HPK GPK : CX}
    (phi : P.obj K ≅ K) (gamma : HK ≅ GK) (gammaP : HPK ≅ GPK)
    (b : Q.obj HK ≅ HPK) (hphi : HPK ≅ HK) (gphi : GPK ≅ GK)
    (epsilon : F.obj GK ⟶ K)
    (BH : P.obj (F.obj HK) ⟶ F.obj (Q.obj HK))
    (BG : P.obj (F.obj GK) ⟶ F.obj (Q.obj GK)) : Prop
